notes.title: 1.11 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.11 Update[/b]

[u]Improvements[/u]

-Added a confirmation prompt when pressing the restart button to prevent accidental restarts.

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]

-Resolved an issue causing the game to freeze under certain conditions.

notes.title: 1.09 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.09 Update[/b]

[u]Improvements[/u]

-New costumes.
-New achievements.
-Secret map – wait, we weren't supposed to mention that.

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]

-Resolved the issue causing online character color changes to not function as intended.

notes.title: 1.08 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.08 Update[/b]

[u]Improvements[/u]

-Timer and Restart shortcut added for speedrunners.

notes.title: 1.06 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.06 Update[/b]

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]

-The bug where looking up or down in single-player mode wasn’t working has been fixed.

notes.title: 1.05 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.05 Update[/b]

[u]Improvements[/u]

-Adjusted difficulty in the "Sewers" region for a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience.
-Widened the outline of platforms to improve visibility and precision.

notes.title: 1.04 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.04 Update[/b]
[u]Improvements[/u]
-Added Spanish language support to enhance accessibility for a wider audience.

notes.title: 1.03 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.03 Update[/b]
[u]Improvements[/u]
-Enhanced the physics of Jumpers to ensure smoother and more consistent bounces.
-Balanced the Jumper area that players found extremely difficult, providing a fairer and more enjoyable challenge.

notes.title: 1.02 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.02 Update[/b]
[u]Improvements[/u]
-Increased the contrast between platforms and the background colors. Platforms are now more vibrant, making them easier to see.

notes.title: 1.01 Update
notes.content:
[b]1.01 Update[/b]
[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
- Local Multiplayer (4 player), player 3 input bug fixed.
